Y0jsEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Son Derece Yüksek IQ’ya Sahip Zihinlerin Gizli Psikolojisi
Y0jsEQAAQBAJ.summary: Yüksek Çözünürlüklü Zihin, çok yüksek bilişsel kapasiteyi ne yüceltir ne de tek başına bir üstünlük ölçüsü sayar. Kitap IQ'nun sınırları, bilişsel hız ve derinlik, asenkron gelişim, yalnızlık, aşırı düşünme, duygusal yoğunluk, duyusal hassasiyet, sosyal maskeleme, yetersiz uyarılma, mükemmeliyetçilik, entelektüel tevazu, hafıza, aşk, iş, otorite, iki kez farklılık ve etik sorumluluk gibi alanları inceler. Bilimsel bulgular aktarılırken örneklem ve genelleme sınırlarına dikkat edilir.
Y0jsEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: Çok yüksek IQ'lu zihinlerin bilişsel, duygusal ve sosyal psikolojisini; yalnızlık, aşırı düşünme, hassasiyet, maskeleme, iş ve ilişkiler bağlamında inceleyen kitap.
learning: IQ puanını insan değerinden ve tüm bilişsel kapasiteden ayırmak.
Yüksek bilişsel hızın yalnızlık, aşırı düşünme ve yetersiz uyarılmayla nasıl birleşebildiğini görmek.
Duygusal ve duyusal yoğunluk ile sosyal maskelemenin maliyetlerini anlamak.
Mükemmeliyetçilik, iş, otorite ve ilişkilerde daha işlevsel stratejiler geliştirmek.
Yüksek yetenek araştırmalarını örneklem ve genelleme sınırlarıyla birlikte okumak.
Y0jsEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: Üstün yetenek, yüksek bilişsel kapasite ve bunun psikolojik-sosyal sonuçlarıyla ilgilenen okurlar için.

FUjsEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: The Hidden Psychology of Extremely High-IQ Minds
FUjsEQAAQBAJ.summary: The High-Resolution Mind examines very high cognitive ability without turning IQ into a measure of human worth or a mythology of genius. It explores the limits of IQ scores, cognitive speed and depth, asynchronous development, solitude, overthinking, emotional intensity, sensory sensitivity, social masking, understimulation, perfectionism, intellectual humility, memory, love, work, authority, twice-exceptionality, darker failure modes, and the ethics of designing a life around unusual cognitive needs. Research claims are framed with attention to sampling and generalization limits.
FUjsEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: A cautious guide to the psychology of extremely high-IQ minds, covering overthinking, solitude, sensitivity, masking, perfectionism, work, relationships, and cognitive design.
learning: Separate measured IQ from human value and from the full range of cognitive ability.
Recognize how high cognitive intensity may interact with solitude, understimulation, and overthinking.
Understand emotional intensity, sensory sensitivity, and the cost of social masking.
Develop healthier approaches to perfectionism, work, authority, and relationships.
Read research on gifted populations with attention to sample limitations and uncertainty.
FUjsEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For readers interested in giftedness, very high cognitive ability, and the psychological and social patterns that may accompany it.

UXTxEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Reusable Skills, Prompts, and Workflows for Building Specialized AI Agents
UXTxEQAAQBAJ.summary: Claude Agent Skills Playbook explains how reusable agent skills differ from one-off prompts, MCP connections, and larger workflows. It breaks a skill into purpose, instructions, procedures, inputs, outputs, checks, and reusable context, then applies the pattern to business operations, development, research, documentation, customer support, sales, testing, evaluation, safety, governance, and distribution. The book includes fifty ready-to-use skill templates and practical blueprints for recurring organizational work.
UXTxEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: A practical playbook for Claude agent skills with 50 reusable templates covering prompts, procedures, business operations, development, research, evaluation, safety, and governance.
learning: Distinguish a reusable agent skill from a prompt, MCP connector, and end-to-end workflow.
Define clear inputs, procedures, outputs, checks, and boundaries for specialized skills.
Adapt reusable skills to business, developer, research, support, and sales work.
Evaluate skill quality and add safety, review, and governance controls.
Compose multiple skills into larger workflows while keeping responsibilities explicit.
UXTxEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For AI builders, teams, consultants, and knowledge workers designing repeatable specialized-agent capabilities.

1XHxEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Practical Prompts, Workflows, and Connectors for Building Real-World AI Systems with Claude
1XHxEQAAQBAJ.summary: Claude MCP Mastery turns the Model Context Protocol into practical design patterns for tools, resources, prompts, files, knowledge bases, business systems, developer environments, data workflows, and reporting. It covers connector design, Claude Code integration, permissions, approval gates, prompt-injection risks, testing, evaluation, regression checks, and deployment. Fifty ready-to-use MCP prompts and three project blueprints provide reusable starting points for personal knowledge, business operations, and developer assistance.
1XHxEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: A practical Model Context Protocol guide for Claude covering tools, resources, connectors, business systems, Claude Code, security, evaluation, deployment, and 50 MCP prompts.
learning: Understand the roles of tools, resources, and prompts inside MCP-based systems.
Design connectors and workflows for files, knowledge, business tools, data, and development.
Apply least privilege, approval gates, and prompt-injection defenses to connected agents.
Test MCP systems with evaluation, regression, and failure-oriented checks.
Use prompt libraries and project blueprints to move from isolated connectors to real workflows.
1XHxEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For developers, AI engineers, consultants, and technical operators building Claude systems that interact with external tools and data.

D3HxEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Practical Prompts, Workflows, and Projects for Building, Debugging, and Shipping Software with Claude
D3HxEQAAQBAJ.summary: Claude Code Mastery treats AI-assisted coding as supervised software engineering rather than unrestricted code generation. It covers safe setup, working-tree hygiene, permissions, secrets, repository mapping, context, feature planning, acceptance criteria, small code changes, debugging and root-cause analysis, refactoring, testing, documentation, code review, security gates, Git, releases, rollback, projects, and a bank of seventy-five prompts. The emphasis stays on evidence, reversibility, and human review before shipping.
D3HxEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: A practical Claude Code guide to planning, coding, debugging, refactoring, testing, review, Git, releases, rollback, projects, and 75 ready-to-use prompts.
learning: Set up Claude Code with safe permissions, clean working trees, and secret-handling rules.
Map a repository and give the model enough context without flooding the task.
Plan features with acceptance criteria and make small, reviewable changes.
Debug root causes, refactor safely, and build regression tests around fixes.
Use code review, security checks, Git, releases, and rollback before shipping.
D3HxEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For software developers and technical teams who want a disciplined, reviewable way to use Claude Code across the development lifecycle.

b3TxEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Practical Frameworks, Prompts, and Workflows for Building Reliable AI Agents
b3TxEQAAQBAJ.summary: Context Engineering with Claude focuses on the information architecture that makes an AI agent reliable. It organizes context into durable instructions, user and task intent, project and domain packs, retrieval and evidence, tool state, long-context prioritization and compression, structured outputs, handoffs, and approval points. Fifty templates help inventory context, detect gaps, define constraints, evaluate sources, interpret tool results, structure workflows, and create reviewable outputs while preserving human oversight for sensitive work.
b3TxEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: A practical context-engineering guide for Claude covering instructions, task intent, project context, retrieval, evidence, tool state, long-context compression, outputs, and 50 templates.
learning: Map the layers of context an agent needs instead of relying on a single oversized prompt.
Separate durable instructions from task-specific intent, evidence, and tool state.
Evaluate retrieval sources and build evidence-first context packs.
Compress and prioritize long context without silently discarding critical constraints.
Design structured outputs, handoffs, and approval gates that keep work reviewable.
b3TxEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For AI engineers, agent designers, product teams, and advanced users building reliable Claude workflows.

Y3TxEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Practical Prompts and Workflows for AI-Powered Knowledge Work, Files, Reports, and Operations
Y3TxEQAAQBAJ.summary: Claude Cowork Mastery presents Claude as a supervised partner for practical knowledge work rather than a chat window for isolated questions. It develops workflows for project context, files and folders, research and synthesis, writing and editing, reports and executive briefs, meetings and follow-up, administrative operations, customer and sales work, data and spreadsheets, decision support, personal knowledge management, and safety. Sixty ready-to-use prompts provide reusable starting points while human review remains central for sensitive or consequential work.
Y3TxEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: A practical Claude Cowork guide to files, research, writing, reports, meetings, operations, customers, spreadsheets, knowledge management, safety, and 60 prompts.
learning: Organize project context and files so Claude can work from the right material.
Turn research and reading into traceable synthesis rather than disconnected summaries.
Use reusable workflows for writing, reports, meetings, follow-up, and operations.
Apply Claude to customer, sales, spreadsheet, and decision-support tasks with review checkpoints.
Build a personal or team knowledge workflow while protecting sensitive information.
Y3TxEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For knowledge workers, managers, analysts, consultants, and teams using Claude for substantial file- and workflow-based work.

baDxEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Pequeñas traiciones que erosionan la confianza en las relaciones modernas
baDxEQAAQBAJ.summary: Microinfidelidad examina conductas pequeñas y repetidas que pueden erosionar la confianza antes de convertirse en una infidelidad convencional. La edición en español de España distingue intimidad de secreto, amistad de desplazamiento emocional, error puntual de patrón oculto y perdón de autoabandono. Mensajes, redes sociales, exparejas, cercanía laboral, personas de reserva, límites digitales, confesión, reparación, quedarse, marcharse y fidelidad madura se estudian con una pregunta constante: qué está ocurriendo realmente y qué necesita la relación para seguir siendo honesta.
baDxEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: Guía sobre microinfidelidad, secretos, intimidad digital, límites emocionales, exparejas, confianza, reparación y fidelidad madura.
learning: Distinguir privacidad de secreto y amistad de desplazamiento emocional.
Evaluar conductas pequeñas por repetición, ocultación, intención e impacto.
Hablar de límites digitales antes de convertir la relación en vigilancia.
Diferenciar un error reparable de un patrón que sigue erosionando la confianza.
Proteger la dignidad personal al decidir si la confianza puede reconstruirse.
baDxEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: Para lectores que quieren comprender mejor la confianza, los límites y la fidelidad emocional en las relaciones modernas.
